howTo: brief = englisch, konkret: wer tut was mit welchem Objekt, welche Emotion, welcher Ort/Epoche. Kein Text, keine Dateinamen, keine Zeiten. shot = close-up | medium | wide | top-down | cutaway | split. protagonist = true, wenn die wiederkehrende Hauptfigur (roter Schal) vorkommt. Beschriftungen/Zahlen gehören als overlay in BILD_AUDIO_ZUORDNUNG.json.

covers.brief: The red-scarf stick figure stares wide-eyed in shock at a single glowing white salt crystal held up in front of its face like a precious jewel, a dark mine tunnel behind it.
A Bronze Age stick figure miner, face lit orange by a burning wooden taper, gasps in awe at a huge glittering wall of white rock salt inside a dark mountain tunnel.
The red-scarf stick figure looks nervous and guilty while hugging a heavy sack of salt like stolen treasure, as a stern royal tax collector glares at it from behind.

scenes.brief: The red-scarf stick figure stands in a cozy modern kitchen and casually tips a salt shaker over a big pot of boiling pasta water, steam rising, relaxed smile.
Cutaway of a steep alpine mountain revealing a narrow tunnel deep inside, where tiny Bronze Age stick figure miners crawl on hands and knees toward a glittering white salt layer.
A Bronze Age stick figure miner in a pitch-dark rock tunnel holds a thin burning wooden taper, its warm orange flame lighting his sweaty, determined face and the white salt wall.
Left side: the red-scarf stick figure shrugs beside a cheap salt shaker on a modern table. Right side: an ancient stick figure guards one white salt lump like treasure.
A Stone Age farming family of stick figures sits inside a dim wooden hut, worriedly looking at a nearly empty storage pit while heavy snow falls outside the doorway.
The red-scarf stick figure stands shivering in a snowy prehistoric village at dusk, arms wrapped around itself, looking at bare wooden drying racks with nothing on them.
A hunk of meat hanging from a wooden beam turns green and grey, buzzing flies circle it, and a stick figure pinches its nose in disgust.
Thin, tired stick figures sit beside empty woven baskets and cracked clay pots in a frozen village, a cold wind blowing snow across the ground.
The red-scarf stick figure raises one hand to stop a Roman officer who is handing a small cloth bag of salt to a legionary, looking doubtful and shaking its head.
A winding road leads from a dark mountain mine entrance down to a stern tax collector at a wooden table piled with salt sacks, travelers waiting in line.
A thin elderly stick figure with small round glasses, a white shawl and a long walking stick walks along a dusty road toward a distant bright sea.
Stone Age hunter stick figures in fur clothing sit around a crackling campfire at night, roasting big pieces of meat on sticks, relaxed and well fed.
Simple bold cutaway of the red-scarf stick figure's body showing glowing nerve lines running from the head down the arms and legs, tiny sparks of energy flowing along them.
A Stone Age hunter stick figure holds up a tiny pinch of white salt next to a big roasted leg of meat, looking amused at how little it is.
Wide view of an early farming village with round wooden houses, small fields of golden grain, goats in a fence and stick figures working with simple tools.
Stick figure farmers carry clay jars of grain into a storage hut while fish and meat hang from poles, autumn leaves falling and grey clouds approaching.
A stick figure rubs coarse white salt into a split fish over a wooden barrel already packed with neatly layered salted fish, looking satisfied.
Stick figures beside a bubbling natural spring pour salty water into clay pots set over a long open fire, white steam rising into the cold air.
Extreme close view into a cracked clay pot where the last water has boiled away, leaving a thick crust of sparkling white salt crystals, the red-scarf stick figure gazing amazed.
An exhausted stick figure drags a huge bundle of firewood past a hillside full of freshly cut tree stumps toward a smoking row of salt-boiling fires.
Cutaway of a tall mountain showing a thick white salt layer hidden deep inside the rock, while the red-scarf stick figure stands at the foot, scratching its head.
A small prehistoric settlement on a dark alpine lake below a steep forested mountain, with Bronze Age stick figure miners entering a timber-framed tunnel high on the slope.
A Bronze Age stick figure miner swings a bronze pick with a wooden handle against a grey and white salt wall, chips of salt flying through the torchlight.
A Bronze Age stick figure miner climbs a steep dark tunnel with a heavy leather sack of salt chunks on his back, bent forward under the weight.
Cutaway of an ancient mine shaft where a long wooden staircase made of logs and planks descends into the darkness, perfectly preserved and sparkling with salt.
A stick figure researcher in a white lab coat studies the tree rings on a cut wooden plank through a large magnifying glass, eyes wide with discovery.
Stick figure archaeologists with helmets and lamps kneel inside a salt tunnel, gently brushing salt off the ancient wooden stairs, faces full of awe.
Modern stick figure miners in helmets ride a small electric mine train into the same mountain above the alpine lake, an old timber tunnel entrance preserved right beside them.
The red-scarf stick figure dressed in simple Bronze Age wool clothing stands inside the narrow salt tunnel, holding a pick, looking around nervously.
The red-scarf stick figure squeezes sideways through a very tight salt tunnel, shoulders pressed between rock walls, its breath visible as small white clouds.
In total darkness, only a thin burning wooden taper lights the face of the red-scarf stick figure and a small circle of glittering salt rock around it.
The red-scarf stick figure sits on a rock inside the mine, spooning a thick bean and barley stew from a wooden bowl, a burning taper stuck in a crack beside it.
A stick figure scientist in gloves holds up a small dark dried lump with tweezers over a glass sample jar, wrinkling its nose but looking fascinated.
Top-down view of a rough wooden table with a bowl of broad beans, a heap of barley, a wedge of blue-veined cheese and a clay mug of foaming beer.
Wide view of an alpine valley where nineteenth-century stick figure diggers in hats carefully open many small graves in neat rows beside the lake.
Close view into an opened ancient grave where an iron sword and a bronze dagger lie on the dark earth beside small clay pots, a brush resting nearby.
Panorama of Iron Age Europe around the Alps with hilltop settlements, traders with pack horses and smoke rising from forges, all connected by winding paths.
The red-scarf stick figure frowns and rubs its chin while standing at the mine entrance, looking out at a long line of people waiting for salt.
Top-down view of a wide green landscape with many tiny villages, but only two small glittering white salt spots far apart, connected by long thin paths.
A long caravan of stick figure traders leads pack mules loaded with salt blocks along a narrow mountain path, while a proud chieftain watches from a hill.
A straight ancient Roman stone road runs through sunny hills, ox carts loaded with salt sacks rolling along it toward distant city walls.
Stick figures in simple tunics shovel white salt from shallow sunlit marsh pools near a wide river mouth, filling baskets, sea birds overhead.
The red-scarf stick figure leans toward the viewer with one raised eyebrow and a knowing grin, a Roman legionary stick figure in a helmet standing behind it.
A Roman officer at a wooden pay table pours salt from a large sack into the open bag of a legionary, other soldiers waiting in line.
Left: a Roman legionary stick figure stares puzzled at a small heap of salt in his palm. Right: the red-scarf stick figure in office clothes holds a pay envelope.
The red-scarf stick figure crosses its arms and firmly shakes its head, while a Roman officer behind it freezes with a salt sack in his hands.
A stick figure scholar sits surrounded by piles of unrolled ancient scrolls under a lamp, searching through them one by one and finding nothing, tired.
A nineteenth-century stick figure writer with big sideburns dips a quill into ink by gaslight, a small Roman helmet and a bag of salt on the desk beside a closed leather book.
An ancient Greek historian stick figure with a beard and a draped robe writes on a long scroll by the light of an oil lamp, soldiers marching outside the window.
Two small silver coins rest in the open palm of a Roman foot soldier stick figure, who smiles slightly, his helmet tucked under his other arm.
The red-scarf stick figure shrugs beside an ancient Roman milestone on a road at sunset, a pouch of coins in one hand and a puzzled smile.
Medieval wooden fishing boats on a grey northern sea haul nets bursting with silver herring, stick figure fishermen pulling hard, gulls diving around them.
Left: a pile of rotting fish with buzzing flies on a wooden dock. Right: a tidy oak barrel packed with neat layers of salted herring and white salt.
A medieval saltworks hall filled with steam, where stick figure workers stir large flat iron pans of boiling brine over glowing fires and rake out white salt.
Horse-drawn wooden carts loaded with salt barrels roll along a sandy road through purple heathland and pine forest under a wide northern sky.
A bulky medieval cog ship with a single square sail leaves a harbor of tall brick gabled houses, its deck stacked with barrels, stick figure sailors waving.
Wealthy medieval stick figure merchants in fur-trimmed coats stand proudly in front of brick gabled houses, counting coins beside stacked barrels of salt.
Top-down view of a medieval brick old town completely buried under a thick white blanket of salt, only church spires and steep rooftops poking out.
A crooked old brick house leans to one side above a sunken cobblestone street with wide cracks in its walls, the red-scarf stick figure staring up at it in surprise.
A Swedish farming family of stick figures sits at a long wooden table in a log house, every plate holding salted fish, a salt barrel in the corner.
The red-scarf stick figure stares in shock at a huge mound of white salt piled on a dinner plate next to a single small fish, a tiny spoon in its hand.
The red-scarf stick figure in a modern kitchen holds up one small level teaspoon of salt, looking at it thoughtfully, a bowl of soup on the counter.
A crowned king stick figure on a throne grins slyly and taps his fingertips together while looking at a long row of salt barrels in his hall.
A grand Tang dynasty courtyard with curved red roofs, where official stick figures in long robes guard huge stacks of salt sacks while merchants wait.
A Chinese official in a long robe weighs salt on a large wooden balance scale and hands the sack to a merchant who pays with strings of round coins.
In a busy Tang dynasty market, ordinary stick figure families buy small bags of salt at a stall, each dropping coins into a box guarded by an official.
Top-down view of a Chinese treasury table with two heaps of round coins, the clearly larger heap standing right beside a pile of salt sacks.
A stern French royal official in a velvet robe and feathered hat stands in a stone tax office beside tall stacks of salt bags, guards with halberds at the door.
A long queue of French peasant stick figures, including children, waits in front of a royal salt warehouse with an armed guard at the door.
An unhappy peasant stick figure family trudges home along a muddy road, struggling to carry a heavy sack of salt they were forced to buy.
The red-scarf stick figure stands in a small eighteenth-century French village street with stone cottages and a church tower, holding an empty salt pouch.
Left: the red-scarf stick figure pays a big pile of coins for a tiny pouch of salt. Right: a Breton fisherman gets a full sack of salt for a few coins.
At night the red-scarf stick figure hesitates at a moonlit river ford with a salt sack, while other smugglers wade across, one holding a shaded lantern.
Royal guards with muskets arrest a group of smugglers on a dark country road, a torn salt sack spilling white salt across the ground.
An angry crowd of eighteenth-century French peasants with pitchforks and raised fists shouts in front of a royal salt tax office with barred windows.
A cheering revolutionary crowd in a French town square tears open salt sacks and throws salt into the air like snow, cockades on their hats.
A short stick figure with a black bicorne hat and a long military coat points firmly at a pile of salt sacks while tax officials hurry to collect them.
A hot Indian coastline at noon with shimmering white salt pans, palm trees and a calm blue sea under a blazing sun.
A British colonial officer stick figure in a pith helmet stops an Indian villager stick figure who is scraping salt from a seaside pan, pointing sternly.
An Indian woman stick figure in a sari hands coins across the counter of a government salt depot, the open sea visible through the doorway behind her.
A thin elderly stick figure with small round glasses, a white shawl and a long walking stick leads a line of marchers in white clothes out of an ashram gate at dawn.
Top-down view of a long dusty road winding through fields and villages toward a bright coastline, a thin line of tiny walking figures following it.
A huge crowd of stick figures in white clothing follows the thin elderly man with round glasses along a village road, people cheering from rooftops.
On a wet beach at sunrise, the thin elderly stick figure with round glasses and a white shawl bends down and lifts a lump of grey salty mud.
Close view of a simple stick-figure hand holding a small lump of mud glittering with salt crystals, the sea and a watching crowd softly blurred behind it.
The thin elderly stick figure with round glasses holds the salty lump high toward the sky on the beach, calm and determined, as the crowd behind him falls silent.
A long beach crowded with Indian stick figures boiling seawater in pots over small fires, white steam rising everywhere along the coast.
Colonial police stick figures lead away calm protesters in white clothes who walk with their heads held high, more people sitting peacefully on the road.
A tiny heap of white salt sits on the ground in front of a massive colonial stone palace, and long cracks spread up the palace walls.
The red-scarf stick figure holds a single large salt crystal up to the light, studying it closely with a thoughtful frown, sparkles reflecting on its face.
Cutaway of the Earth's crust showing enormous white salt layers deep underground beneath fields and towns, with a salty blue ocean at the side.
Wide view of a vast shining salt flat stretching to the horizon beside a deep blue ocean, a tiny red-scarf stick figure standing amazed in the middle.
A row of stick figures from different eras, a Stone Age farmer, a Bronze Age miner, a medieval fisherman and a French peasant, each holding salt.
Top-down view of a landscape where all roads from many villages converge on one single bright salt mine in the mountains, long lines of travelers on them.
A guard stick figure with a spear stands on top of a wall of salt barrels blocking a narrow mountain pass, travelers waiting below with empty bags.
Left: a trader exchanges a block of salt for bolts of cloth at a market stall. Right: a tax collector takes a sack of salt from a farmer.
A nineteenth-century saltworks with smoking steam engines and pumping towers, while a steam train with open wagons full of white salt pulls away.
The red-scarf stick figure opens a rounded vintage refrigerator in a colorful mid-century kitchen, fresh fish and meat inside, an empty salt barrel pushed aside.
A gigantic white mountain of salt at a modern salt mine with a tiny yellow excavator and trucks at its base, under a clear blue sky.
One single small coin lies next to a big bulging sack of rock salt on a scale, and the red-scarf stick figure laughs at how cheap it is.
At night a big orange snowplow truck spreads a wide fan of salt onto a snowy highway, headlights glowing through falling snowflakes.
The red-scarf stick figure stands at the stove again with the salt shaker over the boiling pasta pot, pausing mid-motion with a soft, thoughtful smile.
A Bronze Age miner crawls through a narrow salt tunnel holding a burning taper, the glow of the flame reflecting on glittering white walls.
Left: smugglers carry salt sacks across a moonlit river. Right: a crowd of marchers in white clothes walks toward a bright sea at sunrise.
Extreme close view of a small pinch of white salt crystals falling from above into bubbling pasta water, steam swirling around them.
A lone stick figure miner stands at the entrance of a mountain tunnel at dusk, holding a small burning taper, looking back at the quiet valley below.
